_comment: DEV-TRACK-RECORD-TOOL-PARITY-W1 (CH2) — successor to trade-call-routing-shape-snapshot-2026-08-21.json. The routing contract itself is UNCHANGED and is carried forward verbatim; what moved is the live tool SET. `get_track_record` ships on the tools channel so that harnesses which bridge tools ONLY — DeepSeek Harness bridges nothing else, verbatim: "Tools are the only bridged MCP capability" — can reach the aggregated track record the three trade-tool descriptions cite as their evidence. tools_list_count 7 -> 8; allowed_keys gains get_track_record. The two equity tools remain DECLARED (allToolNames() = 10) and flag-gated OFF the live surface by EQUITY_TOOLS_ENABLED, unchanged by this wave.

get_trade_call.effective_defaults_preserved_in: src/lib/market-route.ts resolveMarketRoute (timeframe -> 15m, exchange -> BINANCE) — existing callers unaffected at runtime
get_trade_call.x402: UNCHANGED — get_trade_call free/un-gated (/x402/get_trade_call -> 404); the get_trade_signal alias stays gated at $0.02

regime_pair_status: get_market_regime + get_equity_regime UNCHANGED this wave (R3 DEFERRED -> OPS-TRADE-CALL-ROUTING-REGIME-W{NEXT}); regime engines diverge materially (equity regime has no timeframe; crypto regime enum is only 1h/4h/1d)

routing_contract.engine: 'perp' | 'equity' — resolveMarketRoute (single-derivation; both get_trade_call and get_equity_call dispatch through it, so the model picking either yields the contract-correct engine)
routing_contract.rule: assetClass forces the engine; else a named crypto venue OR a named timeframe -> perp; else bare -> equity if the ticker is in the Databento universe, else perp BINANCE 15m
routing_contract.default_perp_venue: BINANCE for ALL symbols (venueDefault) — name an exchange to target a specific listing (e.g. BITGET for a tokenized stock)
routing_contract.miss_path: an unlisted perp on the resolved venue -> the engine's standard not-found error (TradFiSymbolUnsupportedOnVenueError carrying suggestedVenues for known tokenized stocks)
routing_contract.membership_source: the existing equity-universe check (getUniverseEntry) via a lazy TTL cache (isEquityUniverseSymbol); fail-open -> perp

additive_only_assertion: Every input change is additive EXCEPT the 2 sanctioned get_trade_call default-key removals documented above. tools/list stays 9; no rename -> no client cache-refresh notice required.
consumers: x402 HTTP twin POST /x402/get_trade_signal (perp-only, schema UNCHANGED — does not share the Zod schema)

cache_contract.description: clients cache tools/list at session start — additive optional params + reworded descriptions need NO cache-refresh notice (no add/remove/rename)
cache_contract._note: SEC-42 (OPS-AUDIT-REMEDIATION-LOW-W2): was a bare STRING. build-knowledge-json.mjs only projects cache_contract when it is an OBJECT, so the public bundle silently dropped it. Wrapped, preserving the original text verbatim under `description`.

drift_check_command: N=$(curl -fsS https://api.algovault.com/capabilities | jq '.tools | length'); test "$N" -ge 8 || { echo "TOOL_COUNT_REGRESSION: $N < 8"; exit 1; }; curl -fsS https://api.algovault.com/capabilities | jq -e '([.tools[].name] | index("get_trade_call")) and ([.tools[].name] | index("get_track_record"))' >/dev/null && echo SHAPE_OK
drift_check_note: SEC-42 (OPS-AUDIT-REMEDIATION-LOW-W2): was `must == 9`; live /capabilities returns 7 and has since the equity tools were dark-retired (EQUITY_TOOLS_ENABLED default OFF) — an INTENTIONAL state, so an equality assertion on a conditionally-exposed surface is guaranteed to fire on a non-defect. Re-expressed as a FLOOR (>= 7) plus a by-name presence assert on the two tools this snapshot actually documents. A floor catches the real regression (a tool disappearing) without breaking every time a flag flips.
projection_note: SEC-42 (OPS-AUDIT-REMEDIATION-LOW-W2): scripts/build-knowledge-json.mjs projects this file into the PUBLIC knowledge bundle and reads the field name `snapshot_date`, with a TOTAL per-field fallback. This file carried its date under a different key, so the public bundle advertised snapshot_date:'unknown' (and, where allowed_keys/endpoint were absent, allowed_keys:[] and the filename as the endpoint) with a perfectly green build. Canonical keys added; the original keys are retained so no other reader breaks.
tools_list_count_note: The live tools/list set, which is what an agent can actually call. This is a FLOOR-checked observation rather than a promise — see drift_check_command. Superseded snapshots of this endpoint recorded 7 (2026-08-21) and 9 (2026-06-09); each was true when it was written. The DECLARED set is 10 (allToolNames()); the two equity tools are gated off the live surface.

not_on_live_tool_surface.note: Documented here ONLY so a reader of the superseded snapshots can see why their contract was withdrawn. These names are not on the live tools/list and must not be called; their input contract, retained for the record, is in the superseded 2026-06-09 snapshot.

withdrawn_input_contract_of_get_equity_c.back_compat: symbol-only callers behave exactly as before (daily-bar equity 1d); a supplied venue/timeframe routes to the perp engine via the resolver
